description: An Estonian entity's beneficial owners (Estonia's e-Business Register, published by RIK, the Estonian Centre of Registers and Information Systems) by registry code or exact current name: each owner's name, date of birth and nationality EXACTLY as the register itself shows them, the manner in which control is exercised (direct/indirect ownership etc.), and the start date of that holding. RIK marks this data as informative rather than authoritative, and the register carries no live per-record API for it -- this tool reads the register's own public company page, live, per request, so data_as_of reflects RIK's own last-updated date for the beneficial-owners section specifically. Anyone named here can request removal at support@pipeworx.io; a removal already on file is silently withheld and counted in withheld_by_removal_request.

name.description: Exact current registered name. Use ee_company_search first for a partial match, or pass registry_code directly if known.
